name: Lumma Stealer (LummaC2)
description: Lumma Stealer (LummaC2) is a long-running Malware-as-a-Service infostealer, sold on dark web forums since 2022 and used to harvest browser credentials, session cookies, crypto wallets, and financial data. In May 2025, Microsoft secured a U.S. court order to seize over 2,300 domains tied to Lumma's C2 infrastructure, with the DOJ, FBI, and Europol disrupting key administration domains and redirecting roughly 1,300 domains to sinkholes. Despite this, Lumma's infrastructure began rebuilding within weeks, and by late 2025 into 2026 infection volume climbed back up via CastleLoader-driven delivery chains and ClickFix-style social-engineering lures. The operation has also reduced its reliance on Cloudflare for C2 domain fronting, shifting toward Russia-based hosting providers to evade re-application of the takedown â€” making it one of the clearest examples of MaaS resilience against law-enforcement disruption.

mitre_techniques.notes: Harvests saved credentials from browsers and password managers
Exfiltrates browser session cookies to enable session hijacking
Delivered via CastleLoader and ClickFix-style fake-CAPTCHA lures that trick users into running loaders
Heavy use of packers and string obfuscation to evade static detection
C2 and exfiltration over HTTPS to rotating, recently-registered domains
Stolen data bundled and exfiltrated directly to operator C2 panels

notable_examples: May 2025: Microsoft, DOJ, FBI, and Europol coordinated takedown seized 2,300+ domains and sinkholed ~1,300
Within weeks of the takedown, Lumma's C2 infrastructure began rebuilding and resumed sales on criminal forums
Late 2025-early 2026: CastleLoader-driven campaigns restored global distribution volume
Operators shifted hosting away from Cloudflare toward Russia-based providers to reduce takedown exposure
detection_opportunities: Monitor for CastleLoader-style multi-stage loader execution chains on endpoints
Flag user behavior matching ClickFix patterns (clipboard paste into Win+R Run dialog followed by PowerShell/MSHTA execution)
Block and alert on known LummaC2 C2 domain patterns and newly-registered domains on flagged hosting ASNs
Audit unsigned process access to browser credential stores and session cookie databases
Deploy YARA/Sigma rules tuned to current LummaC2 packer and string-obfuscation signatures
Enforce phishing-resistant MFA to limit the value of stolen session cookies/credentials
